sections.description:
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ORGANIZATION
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ORGANIZATION
(SERVICE AND FINANCIAL) RULES, 2011
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II,
17th May, 2011]
S.R.O.405(I)/2011,
dated 16-5-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 27 of the
Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Ordinance, 20007 (L of 2007),
the Federal Government has been pleased to notify the following rules,
namely:--
1. Short title,
commencement and application.---(l)
These rules may be called the intellectual Property Organization (Service and
Financial) Rules, 2011.
(2) They shall come
into force at once.
(3) They shall
apply to all employees of the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan:
Provided that any
terms or conditions of service or any other matter provided for in these rules,
which is in any manner less favourable than the terms and conditions of service
in respect of employees absorbed and transferred to Intellectual Property
Organization of Pakistan pursuant to subsection (1) of section 29 of the
Ordinance shall, to the extent of being less favourable, not be applicable to
such transferred and absorbed employees.
2. Definitions.---(1) In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context:
(a)
"Appointing Authority" means the authority or officer competent to
make appointment to a post in the Organization as specified in rule 9;
(b)
"Appendix" means an Appendix to these rules;
(c) "Basic
Scale" or 'BS" means the basic pay scale announced by the Federal
Government as made applicable to the employees of the Organization who stood
absorbed and transferred from the Trade Marks Registry, the Copyright Office
and the Patent Office or those who are on deputation or secondment to the
Organization;
(d)
"Board" means the Policy Board of the Organization constituted under
section 4 of the Ordinance;
(e) 'Chairman'
means the Chairman of the Organization;
(f) 'Director
General' means the Director General of the Organization;
(g)
"duty" includes time spent on,
(i) probation
followed by confirmation or, as the case may be, regular appointment;
(ii) joining time;
(iii} a duly
authorized course of instruction or training, including the time required for
the journey, to and from, the place of such training;
(iv) attendance at
an obligatory departmental examination, including a reasonable time required
for journey to and from the place of examination and the day or days of the
examination;
(v) time spent on
authorized tour and duly sanctioned leave; and
(vi) any extra work
to be performed, under the orders of or with the permission of the Appointing
Authority;
(h)
"employee" means any officer or member of the staff holding a position in Head Quarters of the Organization or
any attached department or office of the Organization including the Trade Mark
Registry; the Copyright Office, the Patent Office or any regional office, but
does not include a person,
(i) employed on a
short - term contract for a period not exceeding twelve months; or
(ii) employed on
work-charge basis ; or
(iii) paid from
office contingencies;
(i)
"family" means wife or wives or, as the case be, husband of an
employee, legitimate children, step-children and parents, whether residing with
the employee or not but wholly dependent on him;
(j) "Federal
Government" means the Cabinet Division, or any other Division concerned
under the Rules of Business, 1973;
(k)
"holiday" means a day declared as such by order of the Organization
and includes optional or a gazette holiday, notified by the Federal Government;
(1)
"honorarium" means a recurring or non-recurring payment granted to an
employee out of the resources of the Organization as remuneration for special
and laborious work of an occasional character;
(m) "House
Rent Allowance" means an allowance granted to an employee if the
Government or the Organization do not provide residential accommodation to him;
(n) "initial
appointment" means appointment made otherwise than by promotion, transf
